policy.statement: A claim is not treated as learned, trained, or validated unless its evidence and verification method are recorded.

records.claim: The v0.3.0 baseline renders one articulated arm chain in renderCharacter and has no screen-left arm group.
records.limitation: This is a source-architecture finding, not a measure of every possible rendered frame.

records.claim: Baseline hand-aim validation compares angles derived from the same wrist-to-target vector used to construct handAngle, so it does not independently validate the rendered pointing gesture.
records.limitation: This identifies a correlated metric design; visual review is still required.

records.claim: Scene schema and regression tests require both screen-left and screen-right arms/hands plus torso, head and legs render groups.
records.verification_method: GitHub Actions workflow 39170991263: scene schema validation, evidence ledger validation, browser HTTP smoke test, node regression tests, seven synthetic benchmarks, raster diagnostic, Python schema tests, FFmpeg render/FFprobe, source packaging and artifact upload.

evidence.symbol: bilateral rig exists in both data and rendered SVG

records.limitation: The CI proves that both arm chains exist in frame state and their required SVG groups render, and that both IK chains preserve segment lengths. It does not certify natural anatomy, artistic approval, collision-free silhouettes, or learned motion.

records.claim: No third-party public motion/image dataset has been downloaded or ingested. The single user-supplied stickman sample is tracked separately under reference.stickman-step-clip.
records.verification_method: Implementation scope: no third-party public dataset adapter or bulk dataset ingestion was added.
records.limitation: The user-supplied five-pose clip is a reference fixture, not a broad external dataset. No model training or fine-tuning is claimed.

records.claim: No model training or fine-tuning has been performed as part of this code change.
records.limitation: The code remains a deterministic procedural 2D rig and motion model.

records.claim: The canonical 96-frame pilot checks the emitted SVG pointing-hand transform against deterministic pose state, including rendered aim, origin, fingertip and hand scale.
records.verification_method: GitHub Actions run 39212642233 on source revision c7641e25973969eb5ea51395f293d20f4cd8a26a passed: 31/31 Node tests, 96/96 serialized SVG frame checks, 7/7 synthetic motion scenarios, Python schema tests, FFmpeg export/ffprobe and source artifact packaging.

evidence.symbol: serialized SVG hand aim and transform mutation regressions

records.limitation: This verifies serialized geometry consistency, not natural motion, collision-free silhouettes, semantic correctness of arbitrary animation or artistic acceptance.

records.claim: The user-supplied five-pose stickman step is represented as a hashed, schema-validated 11-landmark clip and rendered by deterministic keyframe interpolation to a verified silent H.264 preview.
records.verification_method: GitHub Actions run 39228760059 on revision 0e5569ebb87a886649080a832659868afeb2e878 passed: reference schema and exact key poses, 7/7 new Node tests, 4/4 Python schema tests, existing regression suite, 96/96 rendered-pose checks, synthetic motion benchmarks, FFmpeg/ffprobe for the canonical scene and 33-frame reference clip, and artifact upload.

evidence.symbol: five source keyframes; 11 named landmarks; source SHA-256
exact pose, topology, interpolation and trajectory regressions

records.limitation: The source playback rate and exact interframes semantics remain unknown. The new renderer uses an explicit linear baseline and does not claim source-app pixel parity, general human-motion quality, or training.

records.claim: The generic keyframe clip validator and sampler handle synthetic landmark rigs at 6, 27-depth-26, 30, 64 and 128 landmarks, reject duplicated point IDs and enforce source order/root invariants.
records.verification_method: Node stress tests use deterministic synthetic rigs; source data remains the user-supplied five-pose fixture and synthetic coordinates are generated in tests.

evidence.symbol: size/depth regression and corrupt topology rejection

records.limitation: Synthetic topology and runtime robustness do not establish the behavior or performance limits of Drawing Cartoons 2 or artistic motion quality.
